run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Behaviour-preserving refactor that resolves 13 SonarQube findings: splits high-complexity functions into helpers, extracts duplicated status-title literals, removes a duplicate test, and tidies the Dockerfile.
summary.issue_fit: No originating issue; the supplied pull-request text (jonhadfield/soba#195, already merged upstream) is the only statement of intent, and its behaviour-unchanged promise holds by trace.
summary.coverage: All four changed files read in full diff; every refactored function traced against its base for order, log text and error paths; go build, go vet and the internal package tests ran clean (live-provider tests skip). The untracked `.mcp.json` in the clone is outside the committed range and not reviewed.
check_details: Reviewer ran `go build ./...` and `go vet ./internal/` at 136a485: clean.

Reviewer ran `go test ./internal/ -count=1` at 136a485: ok (5.1s); live-provider tests skipped for missing credentials, including TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup, so the refactored Gitea assertions were traced, not executed. The package was run a second time to list per-test results, one run beyond the once-per-flag-set allowance.
The author's `golangci-lint run` result was not reproducible here (tool outside the execution allowance) and is unused.
Dockerfile edits were read statically; Docker is unavailable so no image build was run.
